verdict.rationale: Sentry is an application monitoring platform, so SLO definition with error budgets and burn-rate alerting is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only documents issue-based alert rules and health dashboards, which are adjacent features. Nothing mentions SLO objects, error budgets, or burn-rate alerts.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can define SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts
